tools.name: sun_hours
tools.description: Hours of direct sun per year, and at the winter and summer solstice, at a Norwegian street address, with uncertainty, method and a link. A first request in a new area may answer status 'computing' — call again after retry_after_s.

tools.name: sun_hours_at
tools.description: Same as sun_hours for a WGS84 point in mainland Norway, for a cabin or plot without a street address.
